title: 第二百八十二章 绝境逢生第二百八十一章 朱华音的决心
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
“一刻钟……”
张三喃喃道，目光扫过周围那些陷入昏睡的蜘蛛。
抛下朱华音的选项，张三在一开始就从未考虑过。
所以……时间紧迫！
他必须想办法带朱华音离开这里！
张三眼中闪过决然之色。他不再犹豫，一个箭步冲到朱华音身边，在后者惊愕的目光中，双臂一抄，直接将朱华音拦腰抱起，以公主抱的姿势将她整个人抱在怀中！
“唔！”朱华音的身体骤然僵硬，吹奏的笛声甚至出现了瞬间的断音。她瞪大眼睛看着张三，眼中满是羞愤与不解。
但张三已经抱着她，全力施展鬼影迷踪步，朝着墓园外围疾驰而去！
“朱前辈，继续吹！不要停！”张三一边狂奔一边低喝道。
朱华音回过神来，咬紧牙关，重新将长笛贴在唇边。悠扬的安魂曲再次响起，以两人为中心向四周扩散。
所过之处，那些试图拦截的蜘蛛魂兽纷纷陷入昏睡，为两人让开一条通路。
张三抱着朱华音在坟冢间穿梭，鬼影迷踪步和魂力强化后的双腿跑出残影，速度达到了他所能达到的极限。
夜风在耳边呼啸，身后一块块墓碑迅速后退远去。
然而，就在墓园大门已经映入眼帘时……
“嘶——！！！”
一声愤怒到极致的嘶鸣从身后传来！
那只八万年的血瞳鬼蛛王，率先从安魂曲的影响中苏醒过来！
那八只血红的复眼中燃烧着滔天怒火，八条长腿猛地一蹬，庞大的身躯如同炮弹般朝着两人追来！
紧接着，周围那些精英蜘蛛也陆续苏醒。它们发出尖锐的嘶鸣，汇成恐怖的黑色洪流，对二人紧追不舍！
“该死！”张三脸色一变，脚下速度再快三分。

但抱着一个人的他，速度终究受到了影响。
血瞳鬼蛛王与他们的距离正在快速拉近！
更糟糕的是，张三能感觉到，怀中朱华音吹奏的笛声已经开始变得微弱，魂力波动也在迅速衰减。
“朱前辈，坚持住！”张三焦急地喊道。
朱华音没有回应。她的脸色已经苍白得近乎透明，额头的冷汗顺着脸颊滑落，滴在张三的手臂上。
维持武魂真身的同时持续吹奏第六魂技，对她的魂力消耗是毁灭性的，她能感觉到，自己的魂力已经快要见底了。
终于，在两人冲出一片树林，前方出现一条小溪时——
笛声，戛然而止。
朱华音手中的白银玄凤笛化作一道流光，没入她体内。武魂真身解除的瞬间，她整个人如同被抽空了所有力气，软软地倒在张三怀中，陷入了深度虚弱状态。
而身后，血瞳鬼蛛王已经追至十丈之内！它那狰狞的口器张开，一道粘稠的紫色毒网朝着两人当头罩下！
更远处，数以千计的蜘蛛魂兽如同黑色的潮水，即将将他们淹没！
绝境！
真正的绝境！
content_en:
"A quarter of an hour..."
Zhang San murmured, his eyes scanning the sleeping spiders around him.
Zhang San never considered the option of leaving Zhu Huayin aside from the beginning.
So... time is of the essence!
He must find a way to take Zhu Huayin out of here!
A look of determination flashed in Zhang San's eyes. He no longer hesitated and rushed to Zhu Huayin's side. Under the latter's astonished gaze, he raised his arms directly to Zhu Huayin's waist and held her in his arms like a princess!
"Hmm!" Zhu Huayin's body suddenly stiffened, and the sound of the flute even broke for a moment. She stared at Zhang San with wide eyes, full of shame, anger and confusion.
But Zhang San was already holding her in his arms, using all his strength to use the Ghost Shadow Tracking Step, and galloping towards the outskirts of the cemetery!
"Senior Zhu, keep blowing! Don't stop!" Zhang San shouted while running wildly.
Zhu Huayin came to his senses, gritted his teeth, and put the flute to his lips again. The melodious Requiem sounded again, spreading around the two people.
Wherever they passed, the spider soul beasts that tried to intercept fell asleep one after another, making way for the two of them to pass.
Zhang San shuttled between the tombs with Zhu Huayin in his arms, running out of the afterimage with his ghostly steps and strengthened soul power, and his speed reached the limit that he could achieve.
The night wind whistled in my ears, and the tombstones behind me quickly receded away.
However, just when the cemetery gate came into view...
"Hiss-!!!"
An extremely angry roar came from behind!
The 80,000-year-old blood-eyed ghost spider king was the first to wake up from the influence of Requiem!
The eight blood-red compound eyes were burning with monstrous rage. The eight long legs kicked off violently, and the huge body chased the two of them like cannonballs!
Immediately afterwards, the elite spiders around them also woke up one after another. They screamed sharply and formed a terrifying black torrent, chasing after the two of them!
"Damn it!" Zhang San's expression changed, and his foot speed increased by three points.
But holding someone in his arms, his speed was eventually affected.
The distance between the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King and them is quickly closing!
What's worse is that Zhang San can feel that the flute played by Zhu Huayin in his arms has begun to become fainter, and the fluctuations in soul power are also rapidly attenuating.
"Senior Zhu, hold on!" Zhang San shouted anxiously.
Zhu Huayin did not respond. Her face was so pale that it was almost transparent, and the cold sweat on her forehead slid down her cheeks and dripped on Zhang San's arms.
Maintaining her martial soul avatar and continuing to play the sixth soul skill at the same time, the consumption of her soul power was devastating. She could feel that her soul power was about to bottom out.
Finally, when the two of them rushed out of a forest and a stream appeared in front of them——
The sound of the flute stopped suddenly.
The silver black phoenix flute in Zhu Huayin's hand turned into a stream of light and sank into her body. The moment the martial spirit avatar was released, it was as if all her strength had been drained from her whole body, and she fell limply into Zhang San's arms, falling into a deep state of weakness.
Behind him, the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King had already chased him within ten feet! Its ferocious mouthparts opened, and a sticky purple poisonous net was hooded towards the two of them!
Further away, thousands of spider soul beasts were like a black tide, about to drown them!
Desperate situation!
A real desperate situation!
